text: DSH Capability Inspector 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web profile 的运行时诊断插件，通过注册 inspect_dsh 工具，读取当前 agent 可见的工具、模型提供方与模型目录、Skills、工作区状态及会话持久化能力，并返回结构化报告和警告。用户可选择 summary、tools、models、skills、workspaces 或 sessions 范围；单项能力缺失或检查报错会作为结果呈现。适合排查 DSH profile 当前暴露了哪些能力以及工作区、模型或会话检查为何不可用。使用前无需额外配置。

DSH Capability Inspector adds inspect_dsh to DSH Web. It checks runtime details, visible tools, model catalogs, skills, workspaces, and session persistence. Choose a full summary or one focused area. Missing services and check errors appear in the report. No extra configuration is needed.
想看看当前 DSH 运行时到底启用了哪些能力
怎么查看这个 agent 能用的工具和模型
帮我检查工作区和会话持久化是否正常
DSH 的 Skills 当前有哪些，能不能列出来
模型提供方的模型目录怎么查
某一项运行时能力不可用时，怎么定位是哪块没配置
Can I get a report of the tools, models, and skills available in my DSH profile?
How do I check workspace and session persistence status?
DSH Capability Inspector 的功能「运行时能力汇总」：调用 inspect_dsh 默认生成 summary，汇报当前 Node 运行信息以及工具、模型、Skills、工作区和会话持久化检查结果，并列出不可用或报错项。
DSH Capability Inspector 的功能「按范围检查」：调用 inspect_dsh 并传入 tools、models、skills、workspaces 或 sessions，可单独查看对应目录或状态。
DSH Capability Inspector 的功能「分项错误报告」：诊断时将缺失的注册服务标记为 unavailable，将检查异常标记为 error；模型目录中单个 provider 出错时仍保留其他 provider 的结果。

dsh-capability-inspector README · DSH Capability Inspector：English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**A read-only runtime diagnostics and health-check plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).**

DSH Capability Inspector registers an `inspect_dsh` tool that explains which capabilities are actually available to the calling agent and where a configuration or runtime problem may be occurring.

dsh-capability-inspector README · DSH Capability Inspector：It is also useful when searching for a **DeepSeek Harness Doctor**, **DSH diagnostics**, **DSH capability matrix**, **plugin readiness checker**, or **MCP troubleshooting tool**.

dsh-capability-inspector README · What it checks：- Node.js version, operating system, architecture, and working directory
- Tools visible in the calling agent's scope
- LLM providers and their model catalogs
- Skills, providers, and invocation modes
- Workspaces, directory status, and associated session counts
- Session persistence availability
- Missing capabilities and per-check errors

The plugin never returns API keys or other credential values. It does not change configuration and does not automatically repair failures.

dsh-capability-inspector README · From GitHub：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:tree201/dsh-capability-inspector
dsh web
```

DeepSeek Harness is currently in developer preview. If pnpm asks for build-script authorization during a Git install, review the DSH plugin installation guidance and only authorize source you trust.

dsh-capability-inspector README · From a local checkout：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-capability-inspector
dsh web
```

dsh-capability-inspector README · Use：After restarting DSH, ask the agent:

> Inspect the current DSH runtime and summarize available capabilities and warnings.

More focused prompts also work:

> List the tools and skills available to this agent.

> Check model providers and model catalogs.

> Check workspace and session persistence health.

The agent can call `inspect_dsh` with one of these scopes:

dsh-capability-inspector README · Use：- `summary` — full report; the default
- `tools` — scoped tool catalog
- `models` — providers and model catalogs
- `skills` — skill catalog
- `workspaces` — registered workspace health
- `sessions` — session persistence health

dsh-capability-inspector README · Design boundaries：The first release uses supported, read-only DeepSeek Harness enumeration APIs.

- It does not inspect private Cordis reflection state.
- It does not expose credential values.
- One failed provider or capability check does not fail the whole report.
- It cannot inspect a plugin that failed before this plugin loaded.
- It reports problems but does not automatically fix them.

dsh-capability-inspector README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check
```

The check command runs TypeScript type checking, unit tests, and the package build.

dsh-capability-inspector README · DSH Capability Inspector：[English](README.md) | 简体中文

**DSH Capability Inspector 是 DeepSeek Harness 的只读运行时诊断与健康检查插件。**

它提供 `inspect_dsh` 工具，帮助用户回答以下问题：

- 当前 DeepSeek Harness / DSH profile 实际启用了哪些能力？
- Agent 当前能看到哪些工具、模型和 Skills？
- Workspace 和 Session 持久化是否正常？
- 为什么某个 DSH 插件、模型提供方或能力没有生效？
- 当前故障发生在配置、加载还是运行时能力层？

可以把它理解为 **DeepSeek Harness Doctor**、**DSH 体检工具**或 **DSH Capability Matrix**。

dsh-capability-inspector README · 当前检查范围：- Node.js 版本、操作系统、CPU 架构和工作目录
- 当前 Agent scope 内可见的工具
- LLM providers 及其模型目录
- Skills、来源和调用方式
- Workspaces、目录状态和关联会话数量
- Session persistence 状态
- 缺失能力和检查错误汇总

插件不会返回 API Key 或其他凭据明文，不会修改配置，也不会自动修复问题。

dsh-capability-inspector README · 从 GitHub 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:tree201/dsh-capability-inspector
dsh web
```

> DeepSeek Harness 当前仍处于开发者预览阶段。如果 Git 安装触发 pnpm 构建授权提示，请先阅读 DSH 官方插件安装文档并确认源码可信。

dsh-capability-inspector README · 从本地目录安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-capability-inspector
dsh web
```

dsh-capability-inspector README · 使用：安装并重启 DSH 后，在对话中直接说：

> 检查当前 DSH 环境，列出可用能力和警告。

也可以提出更具体的问题：

> 查看当前 Agent 有哪些工具和 Skills。

> 检查模型提供方和模型目录。

> 检查工作区和会话持久化状态。

Agent 会调用 `inspect_dsh` 并返回结构化诊断报告。

dsh-capability-inspector README · 工具参数：`inspect_dsh` 支持以下 scope：

- `summary`：完整报告，默认值
- `tools`：工具目录
- `models`：模型提供方和模型目录
- `skills`：Skill 目录
- `workspaces`：工作区状态
- `sessions`：会话持久化状态

dsh-capability-inspector README · 设计边界：首版只使用 DeepSeek Harness 公开的只读枚举 API：

- 不读取 Cordis 私有反射状态
- 不显示凭据明文
- 不修改 profile 或运行时配置
- 单项检查失败不会中断完整报告
- 无法检查在本插件加载之前就已失败的插件
- 当前不会自动修复故障

dsh-capability-inspector README · 开发：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check
```

验证内容包括 TypeScript 类型检查、单元测试和构建。
